steps.name: stage
argv:
# The parent and its twelve siblings only ran because a human scp'd
# this file into <payload dir>\src\pipeline\ by hand. This lane is
# not awake to do that, so the job stages its own interpreter and
# refuses to reach the GPU if the bytes are not the ones asserted.
import hashlib, os, urllib.request
base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olegmalk/banyan-city/main/farm-out/jerry-skel-assets-0820/"
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\sapfld5-v12-0821\src\pipeline"
want = ("controlnet_plate.py", "ece54f687d892d1fb1df17211331919bfcb04faac4fe0ee6aa9b0bb231adcc32")
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
with urllib.request.urlopen(base + want[0], timeout=120) as r:
    blob = r.read()
got = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
if got != want[1]:
    print("!! %s fetched with sha %s, expected %s"
          % (want[0], got, want[1]))
    raise SystemExit(1)
with open(os.path.join(dst, want[0]), "wb") as fh:
    fh.write(blob)
print("staged", want[0], got, "->", dst)

steps.name: publish
argv:
# Required by box_enqueue.courier_problems (2026-08-19): a job whose
# artifacts live outside courier-box\farm-out must have a step that
# carries them there, because the courier pushes from farm-out and from
# nowhere else. ep2-cnet-probe-0817 rendered perfectly and was invisible
# for two days for want of exactly this.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/sapfld5-v12-0821/out"
pay_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/sapfld5-v12-0821"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep3-sapfld5-v12-0821"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep3-sapfld5-v12-0821-nocontrol.png*")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/negative.txt"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep3-sapfld5-v12-0821.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 4 else 1)
